priorityList: --- Icy Veins Frostfire Rotation (Hero-Spec Specific) ---
When running Firestarter, delay your first Combustion until the target is below 90% health.

Cast Combustion when ready and then go into the Combustion Priority List below. Cast Combustion near the end of a hard-cast spell. - Click for hard-cast priority Pyroblast with Pyroclasm Fireball Frostfire Bolt Scorch (when target is below 30% health)
Cast Meteor immediately as it becomes available. If you had to delay it more than 10 seconds, skip the usage and save Meteor for Combustion.
Cast Scorch if you have a Heat Shimmer proc, and you do not currently have Hot Streak.
Cast Fire Blast to convert Heating Up into Hot Streak.
Cast Frostfire Bolt as your filler to generate Hot Streak / Heating Up.
Cast Meteor at any point in the last 8 seconds of Combustion, but ensure it lands before Combustion ends. In practice, this means cast it at any point between 2 to 8 seconds of Combustion left.
Cast Scorch when you have Heat Shimmer and no Hot Streak.
Cast Frostfire Bolt as filler.
--- WoWhead Frostfire Opener ---
Frostfire Bolt.
Fire Blast during the Frostfire Bolt cast.
Fire Blast with Heating Up.
Frostfire Bolt
AoE Only: Precast Meteor, before your Frostfire Bolt cast.
Begin a Frostfire Bolt cast.
Fire Blast as soon as the Frostfire Bolt cast begins (if available).
Combustion right before the Frostfire Bolt cast ends.
Frostfire Bolt again, if needed for Hot Streak!.
Pyroblast (or Flamestrike in AoE) with Hot Streak! twice
--- WoWhead Frostfire Rotation ---
Meteor if it will hit during Combustion.
Flamestrike with Hot Streak!
Flamestrike again if you just spent Hot Streak! at the end of a Frostfire Bolt cast.
The below casts are used to generate Hot Streak!:
Fire Blast.
Frostfire Bolt as filler.
Cast Meteor on cooldown, unless Combustion will be up in the next couple seconds.
Cast Meteor right before activating Combustion.
Cast Combustion.
Flamestrike with Hot Streak!.
Cast Fire Blast if you have Heating Up while casting Frostfire Bolt.

Cast Fire Blast if your Flamestrike ( Hot Streak!) just returned Heating Up.In Execute: Cast Fire Blast without Heating Up while casting Scorch. In Execute: If you have Heating Up. Hard-cast Flamestrike with Pyroclasm.
Frostfire Bolt as filler.
